moments.subtitle: In this lesson, we'll explore what Kubernetes is and why it's used.

composition.aestheticNotes: Dark obsidian bg with intense amber radial bloom behind hero text. Warm golden bloom creates neon-sign feel. Text sits sharp on top with high contrast.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0c0a05 fills full frame. primary:#d4820a on 'KUBERNETES' display text. accent:#f5c842 on warm radial bloom (G1) and underline highlight sweep (T3). text:#fefaf0 on supporting body text.
elements: body-text:In this lesson, we'll explore what it is

beat1.description: Display text enters with word-by-word slam cascade. Each word scales 0→1.18→1.0 via spring. G1 warm radial bloom fires simultaneously behind text.
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-12: words slam in sequentially (80ms stagger). Bloom opacity 0→0.6 over frames 0-15.

holdWindow.description: Text breathes (scale 1.0→1.012→1.0). Bloom pulses with subtle opacity oscillation via Math.sin.
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 12-90: main hold period. Bloom oscillates 0.38→0.2→0.38 via Math.sin(frame/45).

beat2OrNull.description: Highlight sweep (T3) fires on 'KUBERNETES' — accent underline animates width 0→100% of word width.
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 25: underline sweep begins, completes by frame 36.

moments.emphasis: The word KUBERNETES slams in dramatically with warm amber glow, establishing topic authority.
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-12: 'KUBERNETES' enters word-by-word via T1 slam cascade, each word spring({stiffness:300,damping:20}) from scale 0→1.0. Frames 0-15: G1 warm radial bloom (amber #f5c842) fades opacity 0→0.6, scale 0.2→1.0, filter blur(55px). Frames 12-90: display text breathes scale 1.0→1.012→1.0 via Easing.inOut(sine), bloom oscillates 0.38→0.2→0.38 via Math.sin(frame/45). Frame 36: underline highlight sweep completes (T3). Frames 90-105: snap-cut exit opacity 1→0.

moments.subtitle: Kubernetes is a system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

composition.aestheticNotes: Forest green bg creates depth. Centered hero element with soft radial gradient. Clean typography with generous negative space. Calm but purposeful motion.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0f1f14 fills full frame. primary:#2d6a4f on central container icon. accent:#e9a824 on key term 'containerized' highlight. text:#e8f5e9 on definition text.
elements: body-text:Kubernetes automates deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications

beat1.description: Hero word 'ORCHESTRATION' wipes in via masked reveal (T5). Supporting pill badges cascade in sequentially (G4) after hero lands.
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-20: masked text reveal (ease-out-expo). Frames 20-35: pill badges stagger in 110ms apart.

holdWindow.description: All elements drift gently via slow sine wave. Text scale breathes minimally.
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 35-90: translateY Math.sin(frame/90)*3 continuous sine drift. Scale 1.0→1.018→1.0 breathe.

beat2OrNull.description: Key term 'containerized' gets color shift (T11) — text color interpolates to accent with subtle radial glow behind word.
beat2OrNull.timingHint: Frame 50: color shift begins, completes by frame 68.

moments.emphasis: The core definition lands gracefully with floating pill badges representing deployment, scaling, and management — the three pillars of Kubernetes.
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-20: 'ORCHESTRATION' masked reveal via parent overflow hidden, mask width 100%→0 ease-out-expo. Frames 20-35: three pill badges (deployment, scaling, management) cascade via G4, translateY +30→0 spring({stiffness:280,damping:20}), 110ms stagger. Frames 35-90: all elements drift translateY Math.sin(frame/90)*3, breathe scale 1.0→1.018→1.0 Easing.inOut(sine). Frame 50-68: key term 'containerized' shifts text:#e8f5e9→accent:#e9a824 via T11 color interpolation, radial glow animates radius 0→45px. Frames 90-105: shrink-fade exit scale 1.0→0.8, opacity 1→0 ease-in.
